reviews.text: Thank you for your trust, Lola and Cristina ❤️
Good and high-quality service. Everything was done on time and with care.

This clinic makes me feel most comfortable when it comes to caring for my dog. When I moved to another location, I decided to ask for recommendations from nearby veterinarians, and they recommended this clinic. Dr. Patrícia Branco always gives Pepe a complete check-up when we go for a consultation and has always been very helpful regarding a surgical procedure Pepe underwent, showing constant concern and expediting processes even outside of regular hours. I can only express my gratitude and highly recommend them!
The doctor was very kind and empathetic. I liked her very much ☺️
My clinic of choice for my cats 🐱 I recommend it 100%. Excellent professionals and very friendly and attentive assistants. 5 stars more than well deserved. Max and Estrela 😻 …

Excellent two veterinarians, both my dog ​​Brownie and my cat Tum love Dr. Patricia and Dr. Rodrigo and all the rest of the staff!
In every consultation there is great care, attention to detail and clear, concise and always accurate explanations!
I only have words of gratitude, I always recommend the Clinic, our little ones will always be in good hands!
I am fortunate to live very close to the clinic. The Clínica Veterinária das Conchas has very competent, attentive, and transparent professionals in their communication.

Excellent service! The Clínica Veterinária das Conchas exceeded all my expectations. The entire team is extremely professional, attentive, and dedicated to the animals. From reception to medical care, the attention and concern for my dog's well-being were remarkable. The facilities are modern and well-equipped, which gave me great confidence in the treatment. I 100% recommend it to anyone looking for a quality and reliable veterinary service!

I've known this clinic since it reopened, and since then I've entrusted my two cats to Dr. Patrícia and her colleagues without any hesitation. Their professionalism, attention, and dedication to the animals is something special. Taking cats to the vet is a nightmare, but at this clinic, and especially with the serenity and knowledge of its professionals, everything goes unexpectedly well! Thank you for all your dedication! 🙌👌
Wonderful clinic, excellent service! We felt completely at ease. Thank you.
Kindness, attention, and affection for our four-legged son. I really enjoyed the experience 👍🏽 …
Dr. Patricia has a lot of empathy and passion for her profession.
